arguments.summary: A lateral movement attack was detected originating from host WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.14), leveraging a pass-the-hash technique using the domain admin account da_jsmith. The attacker established an SMB session to file server FS-CORP-02 (10.0.2.45), installed a malicious service via PsExec (Event ID 7045), and created a scheduled task to execute C:\Windows\Temp\svchost_update.exe. This payload was confirmed as Cobalt Strike Beacon through sandbox analysis, exhibiting command-and-control, persistence, and data collection behaviors. The initial compromise vector was traced to beaconing activity from the same host to a known C2 server (198.51.100.23). Immediate containment actions included blocking the source IP at the firewall. No malicious files were detected by EPP scans post-containment, likely due to memory-resident execution or cleanup.

Alert generated: Lateral movement chain detected. PsExec service installation and scheduled task creation observed on FS-CORP-02.
Containment: IP 10.0.5.14 blocked at firewall via rule FW-RULE-0010.
Post-containment scans: Full EPP scans on 10.0.5.14 and 10.0.2.45 returned no threats detected.
